purpose: Normalisation rules of relic_eval/text_baselines.py frozen before any JCL-SemBench case was loaded by Agent 4; no rule may change afterwards.

collapse_whitespace.excluded: number/amount of blanks between fields and around the statement
collapse_whitespace.limitation: Blank-vs-nonblank in column 3 (name present or not) is preserved as a single blank after '//'; blanks INSIDE quotes are never collapsed. Wrong for in-stream data (hence preserve_instream_data).
collapse_whitespace.rationale: Runs of blanks between fields are not significant (fields are blank delimited).

drop_blank_lines.excluded: empty / blank-only lines outside in-stream data
drop_blank_lines.limitation: z/OS treatment of a blank record is not asserted here; a blank record can be an error or terminate the job stream in some contexts.
drop_blank_lines.rationale: Empty lines outside in-stream data carry no JCL content.

ignore_job_parameters.excluded: operand field and continuations of every JOB statement (name and existence kept)
ignore_job_parameters.limitation: REAL semantic loss: JOB parameters such as COND=, TYPRUN=HOLD/SCAN, REGION=, TIME=, RESTART= and CLASS can change whether/how the job runs. A genuine behavioural change confined to JOB parameters becomes invisible.
ignore_job_parameters.rationale: A JOB statement's name identifies the job; its parameters (CLASS, MSGCLASS, NOTIFY, accounting ...) are largely scheduling/reporting attributes. Mirrors the pre-existing trivial reference textdiff_ignore_job_parameters.

join_continuations.excluded: line-break positions within a logical statement (and the '//' + blank prefix of continuation lines)
join_continuations.limitation: Continuation detection is textual; a comma that ends a comment field or a statement with no operand field but trailing text is mis-read. strip_trailing_comment_field and sort_keyword_operands need this rule (they are no-ops without it).
join_continuations.rationale: Re-flowing a statement over different physical lines (or splitting a long operand field differently) does not change the logical statement.

preserve_instream_data.excluded: nothing is excluded; this rule PROTECTS in-stream data from the rules below
preserve_instream_data.limitation: Data-region detection is heuristic (DD * / DD DATA, DLM=xx, '//' ends DD * data). Mis-detection (e.g. PROC-internal SYSIN, symbolic-driven DD) makes the rule protect the wrong lines or normalise real data.
preserve_instream_data.rationale: Data between 'DD *'/'DD DATA' and its delimiter is program input, not JCL: it must not be re-formatted by any other rule. When ON, data lines are compared byte-for-byte; when OFF they are treated like ordinary text lines (and so subject to whitespace/case rules).

rstrip_whitespace.limitation: Inside a quoted string continued at column 71 trailing blanks ARE significant; they are kept only when join_continuations handles that case.
rstrip_whitespace.rationale: Trailing blanks on a record are not significant in JCL statements.

sort_keyword_operands.excluded: order of top-level KEY=VALUE operands after the positional prefix (sub-parameters inside parentheses are never reordered)
sort_keyword_operands.limitation: Changes positional meaning if a positional operand follows a keyword (then the statement is left unsorted, by design). Order IS significant inside parenthesised sub-parameter lists (not touched) and for duplicate keywords (invalid JCL). Requires join_continuations; skips JOB/IF/SET.
sort_keyword_operands.rationale: VERSION B ONLY. Keyword operands of EXEC/DD/PROC/OUTPUT may be coded in any order; sorting them makes pure operand reordering invisible.

strip_comment_lines.limitation: Comments may carry out-of-band meaning (operator instructions, scheduler directives embedded as comments, '//*%OPC' style control comments); such changes ARE behavioural for those tools.
strip_comment_lines.rationale: '//*' statements are ignored by the system; changing them cannot change behaviour.

strip_trailing_comment_field.excluded: the comment field after the operand field (not for IF/ELSE/ENDIF/SET, whose operands may contain blanks)
strip_trailing_comment_field.limitation: Re-serialises the kept fields with single blanks (so it also hides blank-count differences even if collapse_whitespace is off). A statement without operands but with trailing text, or an operand containing an unquoted blank (e.g. arithmetic in SET, IF expressions in continued form), is mis-split; the exemption list is explicit and incomplete.
strip_trailing_comment_field.rationale: Text after the operand field of a logical statement (separated by blanks) is the JCL comment field and has no effect.

truncate_col71.excluded: columns 72-80 of statement lines (outside in-stream data)
truncate_col71.limitation: Column 72 of a continued quoted string is semantically a continuation flag; it is consulted by the (always-on) structure detector only. Source lines >80 columns or in non-fixed-record files lose real text.
truncate_col71.rationale: Columns 73-80 are sequence numbers and column 72 is the continuation column; the system does not use text beyond column 71 as statement text.

uppercase_outside_quotes.excluded: letter case of all text outside apostrophes in statements
uppercase_outside_quotes.limitation: Real semantic loss for case-sensitive content that is not quoted (z/OS UNIX paths in PATH= are quoted by rule, but unquoted symbolic or member names in some dialects are case-significant); wrong for in-stream data (hence preserve_instream_data).
uppercase_outside_quotes.rationale: JCL keywords, ddnames and stepnames are upper-case by convention and lower case in them is not distinguished by writers reformatting code.
